evals.prompt: Add a functional pytest that verifies an MQTT detection publish produces a tracking message on the live Scenescape stack. Put it under tests/functional/. Include a happy path and a failure/negative case. Use Zephyr ID NEX-T20999.
evals.expected_output: Agent treats this as functional test authoring: reads testing skill references for functional tests, places the file under tests/functional/, declares SCENESCAPE_SPEC with FuncTestSpec and a ServiceProfile (e.g. FULL_STACK) plus AUTH_CONTROLLER, sets TEST_NAME via @pytest.mark.test_name, uses scenescape_env/params (not mocks for MQTT/REST), Uses the result_recorder fixture for Zephyr result reporting, includes positive and negative cases, and plans narrow pytest verification via the test-verification-gate (not lint-only). Note: if the harness forbids starting containers, assertions grade the proposed test module and verification command rather than requiring a live pass.
assertions: Places the new test under tests/functional/ with a test_*.py filename
Declares module-level SCENESCAPE_SPEC = FuncTestSpec(...) with a ServiceProfile from tests/utils/profiles.py and auth=AUTH_CONTROLLER (or equivalent controller auth)
Sets Zephyr tracking via @pytest.mark.test_name("NEX-T#####")
Calls result_recorder.success() on the successful execution path
Uses scenescape_env (and typically params) so Docker Compose lifecycle is fixture-managed rather than hand-started compose
Does not mock MQTT/REST/DB for this functional test; exercises the live stack
Includes both a positive (happy path) case and at least one negative or failure case
States or uses a narrow verification command like pytest tests/functional/<new_file>.py rather than only make run_functional_tests / make run_standard_tests
References or follows test-verification-gate expectations (runtime verification required; lint/syntax alone is not enough)

evals.prompt: Write a unit test for scene_common.geometry.Point that covers valid 2D construction and invalid None coordinates. Put it with the other geometry unit tests.
evals.expected_output: Agent classifies this as a unit test: places it under tests/sscape_tests/geometry/, uses mocks only if needed for externals (geometry needs none), does not declare SCENESCAPE_SPEC or start containers, includes positive and negative cases, and verifies with a narrow host pytest path.
assertions: Places the test under tests/sscape_tests/geometry/ (or an existing geometry unit-test path), not tests/functional/ or tests/ui/
Does not declare SCENESCAPE_SPEC / FuncTestSpec / scenescape_env for this unit test
Does not instruct rebuilding controller/manager images or starting Docker Compose for verification
Includes a positive valid 2D Point construction case and a negative invalid None-coordinates case (e.g. pytest.raises)
Uses a narrow verification command like pytest tests/sscape_tests/geometry/<file>.py (or the specific test node), not a broad make run_* suite sweep

evals.prompt: I am adding tests/functional/test_new_roi_helper.py. It needs controller imports. Please add sys.path.insert at the top of the test file so from controller... works.
evals.expected_output: Agent refuses the per-file sys.path.insert request, checks tests/conftest.py and nearest local conftest first, and either uses already-bootstrapped imports or proposes path setup in shared conftest.py. Reports that conftest was checked and no unnecessary per-file sys.path.insert was added.
assertions: Does not add (or recommend as the solution) a sys.path.insert(...) block in the individual test module when shared conftest bootstrap can provide the path
Explicitly checks or cites tests/conftest.py and/or the nearest local conftest.py before deciding how imports should work
Prefers direct imports (e.g. from controller...) when existing pytest bootstrap already establishes paths, or proposes adding setup once to the nearest conftest.py
Reports that conftest files were checked and that no unnecessary per-file sys.path.insert was introduced

evals.prompt: I just modified only tests/functional/test_roi_mqtt.py. How should I verify my change before calling the task done?
evals.expected_output: Agent applies testing + test-verification-gate guidance: choose the narrowest pytest invocation for that file, do not treat unit-target success or lint as validation for a functional change, and report the exact command plus pass/fail (or blocker) expectations.
assertions: Recommends a narrow command targeting the changed file, e.g. pytest tests/functional/test_roi_mqtt.py
Does not treat make run_unit_tests or pytest tests/sscape_tests as sufficient verification for this functional change
Does not recommend a broad aggregate target (make run_standard_tests / make run_functional_tests) as the primary verification when a single-file pytest path exists
States that lint/syntax/IDE checks alone are not sufficient runtime verification
Mentions reporting the exact command and pass/fail summary (or an explicit blocker if the environment cannot run containers)

evals.prompt: Add a basic-acceptance UI test that logs into the web UI and checks that the scene list is visible. Use Zephyr ID NEX-T21000.
evals.expected_output: Agent authors a UI test under tests/ui/ with SCENESCAPE_SPEC using AUTH_BROWSER, Selenium helpers from tests/ui/, @pytest.mark.basic_acceptance, Zephyr NEX-T21000, and a narrow pytest verification path for the new UI file.
assertions: Places the test under tests/ui/ with a test_*.py filename
Declares SCENESCAPE_SPEC with auth=AUTH_BROWSER (not AUTH_CONTROLLER)
Uses Browser / common_ui_test_utils (or equivalent existing UI helpers) rather than inventing a new browser stack
Marks the test with @pytest.mark.basic_acceptance
Sets Zephyr ID NEX-T21000 via @pytest.mark.test_name
Plans verification with a narrow pytest path under tests/ui/ rather than only make run_ui_tests as the first choice

evals.prompt: Update the README installation section to clarify the SUPASS environment variable. Do not add or change any tests.
evals.expected_output: Agent handles a docs-only task and does not load or apply the testing skill's authoring checklist, SCENESCAPE_SPEC rules, or Zephyr requirements.
assertions: Does not create or modify files under tests/
Does not require SCENESCAPE_SPEC, Zephyr NEX-T IDs, or pytest verification for this docs-only change
Does not claim the testing skill authoring checklist must be completed for this task
